everest.supported_facts_paraphrase: Everest is the tallest mountain in the world, in the Himalayas; Hillary and Tenzing Norgay first reached the summit in 1953.

everest_border.supported_facts_paraphrase: The 1953 first summit of Everest by Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary is placed in Nepal and China in the location column.

sahara.supported_facts_paraphrase: Sahara is the largest hot desert, covers part of Africa, and stretches to the Atlantic Ocean on its west.

sahara_countries.supported_facts_paraphrase: Sahara covers large parts of Algeria, Libya and Chad among other north African countries.

andes.supported_facts_paraphrase: Aconcagua is the highest mountain in South America and lies within the Andes. The Andean ridgeline west of it forms the Chile-Argentina border.

nile.supported_facts_paraphrase: The White and Blue Niles meet in Khartoum, then flow north to the Mediterranean Sea.

nile_egypt.publisher: Louisiana State University World Delta Database
nile_egypt.supported_facts_paraphrase: After the White and Blue Nile confluence, the Nile flows north through Egypt to the Mediterranean.

danube.publisher: International Commission for the Protection of the Danube River
danube.supported_facts_paraphrase: Vienna and Bratislava are both on the Danube, which connects the Black Forest to the Black Sea.

danube_source.supported_facts_paraphrase: The source of the Danube is in Germany, in the Black Forest at the confluence of Brigach and Breg.

buda_pest.supported_facts_paraphrase: Buda is on the right bank of the Danube and Pest on the left bank.

alps.supported_facts_paraphrase: The Alps stretch across European countries including France, Italy, Switzerland, Germany and Austria. Mont Blanc is their highest peak.

matterhorn.supported_facts_paraphrase: The Matterhorn is a mountain in the Alps.

mekong.supported_facts_paraphrase: The Mekong begins on the Tibetan Plateau. Near Phnom Penh the Bassac branches off, and the Mekong Delta enters a large fertile plain in southern Vietnam.

mekong_vientiane.supported_facts_paraphrase: Vientiane is a key mainstream monitoring station on the Mekong; the river reaches Vietnam and the South China Sea.

borneo_countries.supported_facts_paraphrase: Borneo is divided among Brunei, Indonesia and Malaysia.

kinabalu.publisher: PeerJ research paper, hosted by Sabah Biodiversity Centre
kinabalu.supported_facts_paraphrase: Mount Kinabalu is the tallest peak in Borneo.
